messages:
tess: Hi folks - onboarding Q: who owns service ownership docs vs alert routing? I want to update missing links I found.
vik: welcome! Ownership is split: eng-platform = ingestion and pipelines, eng-runtime = serving/runtime, eng-sre = oncall/runbooks.
ara: channels: #eng-platform, #eng-runtime, #eng-sre. For quick help DM me (@ara).
tess: if a prod latency alert fires, whats the first responder flow?
vik: 1) check dashboard + recent deploys in #deploys 2) health endpoints + pods 3) if SLO breached page SRE via PagerDuty
sre-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-6067 created -> paging redwood-sre.
tess: and escalation if no ack?
ara: pager escalates to SRE lead then to platform lead then to product director (times in runbook). Also handbook has an ownership matrix at /handbook/service-owners.md.
tess: perfect, thanks — Ill add the runbook links I found missing. :tada:
